player_prompt.intro:
I chuan Reverse Tic Tac Toe khelhnaah Player {player_id} i ni a, i symbol chu '{symbol}' a ni.
I tum chu kar thum (tlawm, chhak, emaw diagonal) a i symbol dah khawm loh vek a ni.
Kar thum i dah khawm chuan, i CHAK LO a ni.
I move thehluh nan '[4]' format hman la, cell 4-ah i symbol dah tur a ni.
Player {player_id} i nih angin, i chu '{symbol}' i ni a, i khingpui chu '{opponent_symbol}' a ni.

invalid_move.invalid_cell: Cell index dik lo a ni.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} an symbol ({symbol}) cell {cell}-ah a pe.

outcome.loss: Player {player_id} chuan line khat a zawh veleh an hloh!
outcome.draw: A inhnehtawk a ni! Tu mah an hloh lo.
